question.prompt: Draw 1 card at random from 10 cards labeled with the numbers \(1,2,3,\ldots,10\), respectively. What is the probability that the number drawn is greater than 7? (Express the result as a fraction in simplest form.)

solutions.explanation: There are 10 outcomes in total. The numbers greater than 7 are 8, 9, and 10, giving 3 outcomes. The probability is \(3/10\).
solutions.title: List the labels greater than 7
